mapper.sql: id, public_id, order_id, product_id, source_registration_id, buyer_member_id, recipient_member_id, claim_token_hash, claim_expires_at, status, claimed_member_id, claimed_registration_id, claimed_at, claim_request_id, revoked_reason, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: insert into gift_entitlement (public_id, order_id, product_id, source_registration_id, buyer_member_id, recipient_member_id, claim_token_hash, claim_expires_at, status, claimed_member_id, claimed_registration_id, claimed_at, claim_request_id, revoked_reason, create_time, update_time) values (#{publicId}, #{orderId}, #{productId}, #{sourceRegistrationId}, #{buyerMemberId}, #{recipientMemberId}, #{claimTokenHash}, #{claimExpiresAt}, #{status}, #{claimedMemberId}, #{claimedRegistrationId}, #{claimedAt}, #{claimRequestId}, #{revokedReason}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select from gift_entitlement where claim_token_hash = #{tokenHash} for update

select r.id as registration_id, g.status, g.claimed_member_id from gift_entitlement g join marketing_product_order o on o.id = g.order_id join cms_registration r on r.parent_order_no = o.order_no collate utf8mb4_general_ci where r.owner_type = #{ownerType} and r.owner_id = #{ownerId} and g.status in (0, 1) and (r.member_id = #{memberId} or g.claimed_member_id = #{memberId})
mapper.update: update gift_entitlement set status = 1, claimed_member_id = #{claimedMemberId}, claimed_at = #{now}, claim_request_id = #{requestId}, update_time = #{now} where id = #{id} and status = 0 and (claim_expires_at is null or claim_expires_at > #{now})
update gift_entitlement set status = 2, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id} and status = 0
